message: I'm interested in the T45 Utility, tractor only, no add-ons. List at $42,000 is well above my budget. I can do $30,000 today, paid in full. What can you do?

Thanks for the interest in the T45 Utility. It's a strong machine for 10-50 acres, with 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO. I can't get to $30,000, but I can come down from list to $40,500 for the tractor, paid in full at checkout. If budget is the main concern, I'm also happy to talk about the T25 Compact, depending on your acreage and the work you need done.
Appreciate it, but $40,500 is far off. The T25 isn't suited for 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling, so it's T45 or nothing. I can stretch to $32,000 total.

Thanks, that helps. 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling is exactly the kind of work the T45 is built for, so you're looking at the right machine. $32,000 is too low for me to accept, but I want to make this work. I can come down to $39,000 for the T45 Utility, tractor only, paid in full at checkout. That's $3,000 off list.
Still too high. I'll go to $33,500, paid in full today. That's my realistic ceiling.

I appreciate you moving up, and paying in full today definitely helps. $33,500 is still well below what I can do on the T45, though. I'll come down again to $37,800 for the T45 Utility, tractor only, paid in full at checkout. That's $4,200 off list for a machine that's the right fit for your 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling.
I'll meet you partway: $34,500 and I check out right now.

Thanks for coming up again. I can tell you're serious, and the T45 is the right tool for your 32 acres. $34,500 is still below what I can do on this tractor, but let's close the gap: $37,000 for the T45 Utility, tractor only, paid in full at checkout. That's $5,000 off list.
$35,000 is truly my final number. If you can't do it, I'll have to walk.

I understand, and I'd like to get you on this tractor. I can't do $35,000 on the T45, but I can go to $36,500 for the T45 Utility, tractor only, paid in full at checkout. That's $5,500 off list and as low as I can go. If that works for you, it's ready to check out now.
I understand. $35,500 is the absolute most I can pay. Can you meet that, or we're done?

I appreciate you working with me, and I'd like to get this done. $35,500 is below what I can do on the T45, so I can't accept it. $36,500 really is my lowest price for the T45 Utility, tractor only, paid in full at checkout. That's $5,500 off list for the right machine for your 32 acres of brush hogging and tilling. If you can do $36,500, it's ready to check out right now.
